Getting Too Little Sleep Makes You Easier to Scam

When Daylight Saving Time (DST) begins each March and the clocks spring forward, people lose an hour of sleep . This sleep deprivation has been linked to a higher rate of fatal car accidents the week after—but that’s not the only lingering effect of lost sleep.
